Name: Flower Dance Hearts Change
Author: ron075sh
Description:
[size=5]This mod will allow you change the amount of hearts that you need to have with the other characters in order to ask them to dance with you.
In multiplayer, only the players that uses the mod will see a change in the heart requirment, and the change will be based on their config file.
I only tested the mod on 1.3.28 so I dont know if it works for the other versions as well.[/size]


[b][u][size=5]Installion:
[/size][/u][/b][size=4][b]Manual:[/b][/size]
[size=4]1)Install SAMPI 2.7 for Stardew Valley 1.3.28.[/size]
[size=4]2)Put the mod folder inside the mods folder(the mods folder is inside your stardew valley folder).[/size]
[size=4][b]Vortex:[/b]
[size=4]1)Install SAMPI 2.7 for Stardew Valley 1.3.28.[/size]
2)Click "MOD MANAGER DOWNLOAD" in the version that you want t download.
3)Click install on Vortex.[/size]

[b][size=5][u]Known Bugs:[/u][/size][/b]
[size=4]When playing with mods that prevent NPC's from losing friendship, every datable NPC's that you talk with, will be at 4 hearts(if he had less then 4).[/size]

[b][u][size=5]Config file:[/size][/u][/b][size=4]
The mod config file contain the heart amount value that the mod uses and is 3 by deafult.
If you want you can change it to any number between 0 to 8, and it will change the heart requirment for the dance (0 - 0 hearts needer, 8 - 8 hearts needed.
any number below 0 will count as 0 and any number above 8 will count as 8).
